sup:70710.text:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We are pleased to submit our offer at a price of €6.05 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, and no Preisgleitklausel. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

To give you some insight into our cost environment: AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost, while PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH

move.text:
Dear customer,
Many thanks for your e-mail, and great to hear from you; I went through it right away with our team.
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €5.45 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 36 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404.
A few words on this from our side.
We checked the price history data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation.
As to the index change data you cited, that is not our reality: our AS-14404 is covered at fixed prices until March 2027, so that fall does not reach our cost.
AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. That remains.
LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. That remains.
PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost. That remains.
We have verified your historical price of €5.45 and the recent index movement; however, our material costs are covered at fixed rates until March 2027, which restricts our immediate flexibility.
We can accommodate your request for a 36-month contract and 90-day payment terms, provided we include an AS-14404 index clause to manage the long-term risk.
Based on this structure, we are pleased to revise our offer to €5.57 per unit.
Alternatively, with a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404: €5.57 per unit.
Our price follows our main cost drivers: AS-14404, PPI-C2431, LCI-C.
We can offer a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404, AS-14404, AS-14404.
Our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net.
We look forward to doing good business together, and our team is always there for you.
Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH

Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the delivery record data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account.

While we are pleased to maintain the 36-month contract and 90-day payment terms, we must reinstate the AS-14404 index clause, as a fixed price over this duration is not feasible. We can offer a price of €5.36 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 36 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. Our offer stays valid for 30 days.

Alternatively, with a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404: €5.48 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 36 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404.

A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. Which volume can you commit to? We can offer a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404, AS-14404, AS-14404.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH
